description: This file defines a controller class for managing marketing affiliates in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, filtering, and managing affiliate data, as well as generating URLs and handling request parameters.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliate marketing features within the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: ControllerMarketingAffiliate
classes.description: The main controller class managing marketing affiliate operations such as create, update, delete, calculate, and export affiliate data within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the affiliate management interface with filtering options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to list affiliates, returning JSON or HTML as needed.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Protected method that generates the filtered list of affiliates based on request parameters.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating affiliate information, including validation of input data and affiliate existence. It responds with JSON for success or error states.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected affiliates based on provided IDs, after permission check, and returns success or error response as JSON.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs a balance calculation for all active affiliates, updating their balances based on transactions, with permission validation.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Generates a CSV report of selected affiliates, including their payment details and balances, and initiates a file download with appropriate headers.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Handles the finalization process, such as completing an affiliate setup, setting language, and returning a JSON response indicating success or permission errors.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the affiliate report by calling the internal getReport method and setting the output.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves detailed affiliate report data including transaction history, store info, and pagination details, producing a report view with the compiled data.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete feature for affiliate names or emails, returning a JSON array of matched affiliates sorted alphabetically.
